note: Floor and wall textures (brief 02d). Presets are free files in public/surfaces/ (made by scripts/make-surfaces.ts). Photo and describe cost costs.surface in cubes.json. Every texture is 1 m x 1 m and repeats once per meter.

generate.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of {subject}, seen straight on, flat even light, no perspective, no shadows, no objects. Exactly 1 meter by 1 meter.

tone.note: Generated textures come out a little flatter so the layout stays readable.
